capabilities.description: Builds and certifies Interim Payment Certificates against the BOQ source of record, applying 5% retention per Clause 14.3 and tracking retention release (50% at Taking-Over, 50% at end of Defects Notification Period).

Computes delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% per Clause 8.7, and tracks Time for Completion of 730 days from the Commencement Date against Clause 8.2.
Registers project documents with provenance and hashing, including the uploaded contract and BOQ as source-of-record, and supports register search, version tracking, and audit.
Manages QA inspection and test plan records linked to BOQ work items, with evidence capture, approval rules, and audit trail for quality sign-offs.
Extracts and governs the contract's time, retention, performance-security, and delay-damages terms as the source of record so other capabilities apply them consistently.
Tracks the 10% performance security required under Clause 4.2 and its status across the contract period.
